limitations: Synthetic molecular proposals with actual local pose computations; not synthesized compounds
Scores are Vina model scores, not measured binding affinity
Hydrogen bonds depend on ligand/protein preparation and distance/angle criteria
Rigid receptor, water removal, one ligand tautomer and small pose budget are approximations
Unspecified proposal stereochemistry can become one stereochemical realization in3D; isomer enumeration was not validated
Protocol chosen on four known CDK2 structures; not a held-out generalization benchmark

checks: Every saved pose preserves connectivity and explicitly specified proposal stereochemistry
Contact atom indices/coordinates/distances agree with saved pose and receptor
Selected-pose physicality rerun matches saved outcomes
Every generated conformer accounted for by artifact or documented error
guided_batch_audit.scientific_scope: Integrity of computation; no experimental affinity, synthesis, or pose accuracy for new proposals established

checks: Every saved SDF matches known ligand graph
Independent RDKit CalcRMS agrees in protein frame within SDF coordinate precision
Every saved Vina score matches process output
soft_anchor_audit.scientific_interpretation: Integrity passing does not mean predictive accuracy passed; NU6102 remains a receptor-dependent pose failure.

interpretation: Retrospective CDK2 calibration and fresh stochastic batch. No affinity or generalization validation. NU2058 is a self-control.
